pendingClarifications.detail: Source consensus R-08 requests 1900-2100. Current accepted service design and immutable contract constrain 1901-2099. No range or frozen projection was changed.
Source R-21 asks for 主生客，相得 / 客生主，相得. This audit verifies Service faithfully copies Domain relation fields; it does not approve a Domain/UI text change.

Old Phase2-A explicitly maps Domain RangeError after normalization to 400 and boundary.test.ts intentionally maps an inverted provider sequence to 400. Later time design says expected Domain invalid input 400 and provider failure 503 without explicitly reclassifying malformed return values. Both service and time reviewers agreed not to overturn the explicit historical test on inference.
